44594.title: The wizard opens only from defined entry points when something is collectable

blocks: 1. Sign in as an Owner or Admin (completion permission).

2. Open, via top menu "Work Orders" -> the "Work Orders" tab -> open a work order -> its "Lines" tab, a work order that has something outstanding (e.g. a line missing a required tech story, an unpicked inventory part). The completion wizard opens from "Create invoice" (in the work order header three-dot / more_vert menu) when something is still collectable; it shows step pills across the top (e.g. "Tech stories (1)", "Pick parts (2)", "Missing Details (1)") each with a count, and each step carries its own action button (Save Story / Pick all / Receive parts) that saves and advances - there is no Continue button. Also try opening it from the other finish paths (bulk complete, clock out and complete).

blocks: 1. The wizard opens from exactly these entry points: Complete on a line; Complete lines; Complete all lines; Create invoice; Clock out and complete - and from nothing else (no timer, no background job, no side effect).
2. It opens only when something required is both outstanding and collectable; if nothing is, the action completes immediately and no wizard appears.
3. Collectable means: a missing tech story, a missing mileage or engine hours reading, an unpicked inventory part, an unresolved core, or an unreceived part.
4. Mark as reviewed never opens the wizard (it only becomes available once every line is complete).
5. The run records which lines it covers and whether it is heading to an invoice, fixed when the run opens.
6. A step the user's role cannot perform is not shown; where that step is the only outstanding work, the action fails with the reason instead of opening an empty wizard.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8683 and story SV-9262 (Story 16, When the completion wizard opens) and the Simple Flow V2 specification (Confluence page 771391574, revised 8 September 2026), read on 9 September 2026.
Last checked against build v26.35.9-5700a76 on 9/9/2026.
